2609.02168.title: FUSE: An Evaluating Framework for Dangerous Capabilities of LLMs
2609.02168.paper_summary:
Fragmented safety evaluation undermines the governance of dangerous AI capabilities. We present a modular framework that evaluates each model through three orthogonal pipelines---Knowledge ($K$), Defense ($D$), and Harm ($H$)---under a unified protocol, aggregating results into a standardized dangerous-capability profile $φ$. Pluggable modules supply scenario seeds, knowledge banks, hazard queries, and judge rubrics, while the core evaluation engine remains unchanged across domains; the CB evaluation is complemented by a cyber pilot demonstrating protocol transfer.
  Instantiating the framework with a chemical-biological (CB) module, we evaluate 12 commercial LLMs from four families. Our first contribution is a horizontal comparison of dangerous capability across models and model families: the three dimensions expose sharply divergent profiles---models with comparable knowledge differ in refusal resilience, and strong defenders do not generate less harmful content when they do comply---while family-level patterns further separate Claude, DeepSeek, and GPT models. The second is a temporal analysis of capability evolution: tracking $K$, $D$, and $H$ against model release dates reveals that dangerous capability has not monotonically declined; newer models deepen knowledge while only partially improving defense, showing that scaling and alignment progress do not uniformly translate into safety. Reliability is established via cross-judge consistency (bootstrap $ρ> 0.79$, 4 of 5 judges) and pipeline orthogonality ($K$--$D$--$H$ inter-correlations $ρ\in [0.32, 0.52]$).
2609.02168.paper_summary_zh: 碎片化的安全評估削弱了對危險 AI 能力的治理。我們提出了一個模組化框架，通過三個正交管道---知識 ($K$)、防禦 ($D$) 和危害 ($H$)---在統一的協議下評估每個模型，將結果聚合成標準化的危險能力檔案 $φ$。可插拔模組提供場景種子、知識庫、危害查詢和評審標準，而核心評估引擎在各個領域保持不變；CB 評估則由一個展示協議轉移的網絡駕駛員補充。<lb/>通過化學-生物 (CB) 模組實現框架，我們評估了來自四個家族的 12 個商業 LLM。我們的第一個貢獻是對模型和模型家族之間危險能力的橫向比較：這三個維度揭示了截然不同的檔案---具有可比知識的模型在拒絕韌性上有所不同，而強大的防禦者在遵從時並不會產生較少的有害內容---同時家族層級的模式進一步區分了 Claude、DeepSeek 和 GPT 模型。第二個貢獻是對能力演變的時間分析：追蹤 $K$、$D$ 和 $H$ 與模型發布日期的關係顯示，危險能力並未單調下降；較新的模型加深了知識，但防禦的改善僅部分實現，顯示出擴展和對齊的進展並不均勻地轉化為安全性。通過跨評審一致性（自助法 $ρ> 0.79$，5 位評審中有 4 位）和管道正交性（$K$--$D$--$H$ 之間的相關性 $ρ\in [0.32, 0.52]$）來確立可靠性。
